Another Civil War
A few days ago the 24th Army
(General Liu Wen-huei) and the
28th. Army (General Den Hsi-heo)
commenced to fight.
It
was
thought by many that the
28th
army would soon be crushed.
But
these prophets were soon
disap-
pointed. General Den has display-
ed very good tactics. He retreated
across a river about 30 li (10
miles) from Chengtu and entrench-
ed himself firmly
there.
Bridges
were destroyed and the 28th army
tried in vain to cross the river in
face of the tremendous fire of the
28th army.
They tried to cross
on rafts but the rafts were de-
stroyed and many soldiers
shot or
drowned. Also the 28th laid many
traps and played many tricks on
the 24th.
Peace Negotiations Fail
Soon a stalemate occurred and
fighting
stopped for
awhile.
Negotiations took place
with a
view to trying to come to a peace.
But we hear that these have been
unsuccessful and fighting is to be
resumed.
Poor China and poor Szechwan!
They do not seem to be able to
unite-even in face of serious for-
eign dangers.
